summary_en: Dividend per share raised to ¥170 (¥85 interim + ¥85 year-end) from ¥120 forecast issued 2026-05-14. Increase of ¥50/share (+42%). Progressive dividend policy maintained. Total shareholder payout target 40%.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Denyo announced on 2026-07-31 a revision to its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending 2027-03-31. The company raised its full-year dividend per share from ¥120 (¥60 interim + ¥60 year-end) to ¥170 (¥85 interim + ¥85 year-end), representing an increase of ¥50 per share or 42%. The revision reflects management's commitment to enhanced shareholder returns through progressive dividend policy while maintaining capital investments in R&D and facilities to strengthen long-term competitiveness and financial health. The company targets a total payout ratio (dividends plus share buybacks) of approximately 40% as its basic capital allocation policy.
